Slow orders, agitated tercile, 25 s horizon. Lighter LIT perpetual, 79 days between 6 March and 29 June 2026.

the day with the zero-price reference
historical rule, as coded in July 2026
wider rule: also counts orders that vanished while trades printed both at and through their price
The wider rule gives the lower value on 73 of 79 days. Mean paired difference −15.66 bps, descriptive t −6.90.
Each horizon averaged over its events.
